verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB lets users turn any SQL query into a monitored rule with an operator, threshold, interval, severity and templates (docs-21). These rules attach to reusable Slack and HTTP webhook destinations (docs-22), so a condition firing automatically triggers an outbound action. Materialized and refreshable materialized views also run automatically on insert or schedule (docs-34, docs-36). missing for 10: native action types beyond notification and webhook delivery, rules triggered by arbitrary events rather than interval-polled thresholds, detailed docs on rule execution semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
